texts.text: <color=#515aee>Ever so cunning... ever unhesitant... and... ever caring.</color>

You...

texts.text: No.

"Stop fumbling like a mediocre bunch and tell me where we're at, Clock."

texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <Y-yeah...>

texts.text: "Annoying b—"

texts.speaker: Kromer's Sister

texts.text: ... How did you get here?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Me? Oh, I thought I told you already: I can go anywhere, as long as it's not the Fount.

texts.speaker: Kromer's Sister

texts.text: Anyway, just how long are you people planning on dilly-dallying?
texts.speaker: Kromer's Sister

texts.text: Any reason we shouldn't D.D.?

texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <About that... I was thinking we'd take our time and look around first.>

texts.text: Ugh. This stupid tick-tocking... Can you do that over there—not so close to me? Things without flesh make me uncomfortable, fancy clothes or not.
texts.speaker: Kromer's Sister

texts.text: I seem to have heard a rude comment directed at the Executive Manager that I wouldn't normally let slide, but let me ask you something first.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: ... You've been nagging for a while. What are you plotting?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Really now? Haha! You really don't know what's coming for you? That snuffling, don't you hear it? It's so loud!
texts.speaker: Kromer's Sister

texts.text: My word... Poor little dears. You have no clue, do you?
texts.speaker: Kromer's Sister

texts.text: You'd better start running if you're really that clueless... Not that it'll help, but what else can you do?
texts.speaker: Kromer's Sister

texts.text: <... Did she just walk into that wall?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: We've hit a D.E. My scabbard isn't enough to cut through it, and the sword refuses to be drawn.
texts.speaker: Ryōshū

texts.text: ... We should scout the area and locate this "Skein Nest," Executive Manager.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <Do you know where it is, Meursault?>

texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <Good. Let's be on our way.>

texts.text: Back already...? It hasn't been that long since you went down...

texts.text: <... Not sure about the enraged part, but yeah, that's what happened.>

texts.text: That thing was enraged, C.H.
texts.speaker: Ryōshū

texts.text: I can't say why I'm so sure about it, but there was no mistaking the emotion pouring out of it.
texts.speaker: Ryōshū

texts.text: <Either way, that clears up what's making that "snuffling" sound Kromer was talking about. It's probably...>

texts.text: Yes, Executive Manager. There is a high probability she meant that cocoon.

If it's still wandering nearby... we will need countermeasures.

texts.text: Um... Did you happen to run into that Kromer woman again?
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: She suddenly appeared out of thin air, mocked us, and then walked into a wall before we could retort.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <... She didn't seem to be planning to attack us, at least not at that moment... Just like when we first met her.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <But yeah, she didn't seem interested in lending any help either...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: N.O.W.
texts.speaker: Ryōshū

texts.text: ... Never off watch... Yeah. She's a Kromer, after all. Can't let our guard down.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: <Let's head back out and look for another way.>

texts.speaker: Kromer's Sister

texts.text: Hehe, now that that's sorted, you're all free to dilly-dally like you wanted!
texts.speaker: Kromer's Sister

texts.text: <... It's not like we dawdled because we wanted to.>

You seem to be fond of making an appearance without so much as a hint. Do you just enjoy playing god, or have you been indulging yourself for so long that it's become who you are?

Kromer.

Yes.

<... We should get going as well.>

You're...

texts.text: Do you still remember how to make it?

texts.text: But there's—

texts.text: <... What?>

texts.text: Even if it were real, the world wouldn't be any different.

texts.text: So it is.

texts.text: It's just a colorless something. You can't really dye anything with it.

texts.text: S.L.O.P.

texts.text: ... R-right...

texts.text: Thread spun under hindrance shall never yield a color of beauty.
texts.speaker: B2F Floor Manager

texts.text: A thing coveted by many will invite much hindrance.
texts.speaker: B2F Floor Manager

texts.text: Something is violently crashing through the corridor toward where we were.
Had that black entity heard the cries and returned for the cocoon?
... Sounds as though she wants us to defend this position while she spins the thread.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: I recommend immediately fortifying the corridor entrance leading to this position, Executive Manager.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <... Let's do that.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: With this... every last strand has been drawn.
texts.speaker: B2F Floor Manager

texts.text: Do you have a spool for it?
texts.speaker: B2F Floor Manager

texts.text: Not yet.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Then make it into a tangle of yarn and take it with you.
texts.speaker: B2F Floor Manager

texts.text: With this... we have obtained the Golden Skein listed in the recipe.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <Good work, everyone. Let's return to the third floor.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Now... go back.
texts.speaker: B2F Floor Manager

texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Quiety-quiet... You... need needles? Will you be quiety-quiet if you get to buy needles?
texts.speaker: Red Needlekin

texts.text: I've got some things I have no use for. I'll let you purchase those from me, as a special favor.
texts.speaker: Naked

texts.text: I'm busy, so choose quickly. And don't get any funny ideas.
texts.speaker: Palette

texts.text: Spools of pure white thread are wound here.
It seems to be a spinning machine of sorts. The contraption is spewing strands of threads at a constant, even pace.
Strands of thread spill forth, winding themselves around the spool. Where could they be coming from?
This is the wall Kromer "walked into." It's not an illusion or anything—she really just phased into a solid wall.
Worthless B.S. on the floor. Did that woman drop it?
texts.speaker: Ryōshū

texts.text: <Well, judging on how she's been interacting with us.. she probably left it here on purpose.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <Meursault, take it for now. It might come in handy.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Understood, Manager.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: The machine looks complicated to operate.
<Meursault, do you know how to operate this?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: I am not familiar with the work procedures of Sisyphe's lower floors.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Meanwhile, Outis began manipulating the machine's complex display.
Hm... I do not yet understand the operating principle, but I have a general grasp of the structure.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <Oh, wow...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: The interface presents three functions: extraction, spinning, and dyeing. Your orders, Executive Manager?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Three buttons appear on the display Outis indicates.
There are three buttons on the screen.
With a disconcerting whir, the machine sucked a patch of Meursault's skin onto its surface.
Huh. These threads are O. of a K.
texts.speaker: Ryōshū

texts.text: With a disconcerting whir, the machine sucked a patch of Meursault's skin onto its surface.
With a disconcerting whir, the machine sucked a patch of Meursault's skin onto its surface.
... Are... you going to press it again, Executive Manager?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: With a disconcerting whir, the machine sucked a patch of Meursault's skin onto its surface.
You want it S.I.T.?
texts.speaker: Ryōshū

texts.text: She is asking whether your objective is to have the skin "split into threads," Manager.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <N-no, that's not what I'm doing... But has Sinclair ever interpreted that one before?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: He has interpreted "S.E.N.I.T." before on the bus. It stands for "split every nerve into threads."
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <I really don't remember what the context was when she said it.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: A spool of thread plopped out of the contraption.
It appears to be thread made from... Meursault's skin.
There shouldn't be any reason to press this button again.
The threads twang lightly as the machine pulls them tight.
They're starting to multiply...
... Uh, we weren't told anything about increased production volume.
texts.speaker: Needlekin Laborer

texts.text: Don't you think you're going a little too fast? Slow down with the threads over there!
texts.speaker: Needlekin Laborer 2

texts.text: ... The customers working nearby are glaring daggers at us.
... The accusatory glares around me are too sharp to risk pressing it again.
A warning states that no dye is available.
Nothing happened.
With all due respect, Executive Manager... may I ask what exactly it is that you intend to accomplish?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <... I mean... Sometimes you just want to mash some buttons, right?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: As I try to hammer the button once more, something taps my elbow.
I turned to find Ryōshū's scabbard, Araya.
For a moment, I could swear I heard it say, "You really should stop acting like a kid..."
Yeah, I should stop. This is getting ridiculous.
Neatly folded stacks of dyed fabric are piled here.
Dyed fabrics hang here.
Hurried footsteps come racing from somewhere as I inspect the fabric.
Dyed fabrics hang here.
Hurried footsteps come racing from somewhere as I inspect the fabric.
Dyed fabrics hang here.
A sound resembling the rumble of a train comes from beyond the door.
As I move closer to investigate, the light leaking through the gap grows steadily brighter.
<Aaargh!!>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: ...! Executive Manager!
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Are you unharmed?! What did you see?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <I heard something like a train... and then this huge flash of light came through...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Outis scrutinizes every inch of the gap, then points as though she has found something.
Something is lodged inside. Meursault, can you remove it?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: I can.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Meursault removes an eyeball from the gap.
The intermittent sounds of train horns and people murmuring are coming through the gap.
It's a sky-blue dye with a particularly pure hue.
A note beside it reads, "Dye under testing. If you intend to use it, take only a little..."
... Not bad. It has some aesthetic value.
texts.speaker: Ryōshū

texts.text: No eyeball payment appears to be required. It should be okay to requisition a small sample.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <Let's fill just one container, Meursault.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Obtained a sample of sky-blue dye.
Nothing but pitch-black darkness. Meursault reaches toward a tiny twinkle of light so faint that it is almost impossible to notice.
Meursault obtained Sawdust.
Green dye.
Looking at it brings a sense of serenity.
A dye with a yellow hue. At a glance, it almost appears golden.
Strangers. That's not the Golden Dye, so stop hovering around it.
texts.speaker: Palette

texts.text: Blue dye. Ryōshū turns her head away, looking displeased. Perhaps the azure hue reminded her of the blue glow of the Pinky Nursefather's Corridor.
Araya, on the other hand, is rattling happily as we approach the blue dye. Maybe blue is her favorite color.
A container filled with red dye. "TO BE DELIVERED TO B3" is written along its side.
A sofa painted in a riot of colors.
Whenever I try to sit, the person beside Palette fixes me with a vicious glare.
Ryōshū levels her with a reciprocative glare of her own. Her scabbard sways behind her. Somehow, the motion seems like the wave of a hand of someone trying to stop a fight.
What looks like a department-store directory is glued on a drink vending machine. Damage has obscured most of the lettering.
What looks like a department-store directory is glued on a drink vending machine. Damage has obscured most of the lettering.
Mangled flesh peeks from beneath the tiny scrap of cloth.
Pulverized flesh peeks from beneath the tiny scrap of cloth.
It's exploded into a mess of yellow dye and flesh. It's difficult to imagine what it could've looked like before.
It's exploded into a mess of red dye and flesh. It's difficult to imagine what it could've looked like before.
It's exploded into a mess of blue dye and flesh. It's difficult to imagine what it could've looked like before.
<It's just a corpse.>
<It's just a corpse.>
<It's just a corpse.>
<It's just a corpse.>
It's filled with a sky-blue dye with a particularly pure hue.
A bucket full of blue dye.
A bucket full of purple dye. The label on the side says "PURITY - ADEQUATE".
A bucket full of blue-ish purple dye. The label on the side says "PURITY - NOT YET CHECKED".
A bucket, slowly filling with reddish purple dye. The label on the side says "PREMIUM GRADE".
Says "TO BE DISCARDED". On second look, it does look a bit cloudy.
Ohh, maybe this is the Golden Dy—ah. There's a label that says "NOT THIS ONE" taped on the side of the bucket. Guess this isn't it...
Must get these mixed up all the time.
The label reads: "DISPOSAL".
A green dye bucket.
This bucket is sealed tight.
Tried opening it, but the seal would not give.
Are you the one called Naked?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: ... Customers, looking for me? What do you want?
texts.speaker: Naked

texts.text: Hm... I see.
texts.speaker: Naked

texts.text: But I cannot do that.
texts.speaker: Naked

texts.text: Hmm... Perhaps more eyeballs can—
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Don't bother. You can't persuade me with it.
texts.speaker: Naked

texts.text: The whole reason I spent season after season on the basement floors, watching countless trends pass me by... was to make an outfit magnificent enough to carry me higher—to the fifth floor. That singular purpose made coming down here all worth it.
texts.speaker: Naked

texts.text: Without the Golden Dye, that dream means nothing.
texts.speaker: Naked

texts.text: If you had a dye of equal value... perhaps I could be persuaded.
texts.speaker: Naked

texts.text: Does such a dye even exist?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: This is only a rumor, but... they say there is a dye of exquisite hue, visible only to the pure of heart. More magnificent than even the Golden Dye.
texts.speaker: Naked

texts.text: <What does it look like to someone who isn't pure...?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: *puff* Like nothing, obviously. Invisible.
texts.speaker: Ryōshū

texts.text: <Who would even wear clothes dyed in something like that?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: This guy, apparently.
texts.speaker: Ryōshū

texts.text: Ryōshū shrugged, flicked her cigarette to the ground, and crushed it beneath her heel.
I believe it's called L'Incolore. Bring me that dye, and I will barter the Golden Dye for it.
texts.speaker: Naked

texts.text: It's probably rarer than the Golden Dye—and far more striking, too.
texts.speaker: Naked

texts.text: ... Is Palette aware of its existence?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Well, I wouldn't know—never asked her. Perhaps she does have it in her production line, who knows.
texts.speaker: Naked

texts.text: Besides, even if she had a dye that valuable, I'd have to wait ages before I could get my hands on it, since I failed to camp out before opening. And after how much I waited to get the Golden Dye... I don't think I've got it in me for another wait.
texts.speaker: Naked

texts.text: Hm? My turn has come, it seems! I have to go collect my dye.
texts.speaker: Naked

texts.text: Wait, let us—
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Easy there. I've got no problem making a trade if you can really bring me some L'Incolore. I can't head upstairs for the rest of this season anyway.
texts.speaker: Naked

texts.text: I'm planning to stick around nearby. Come see me once you've obtained the L'Incolore. Anyway, I'm off—got Golden Dye to collect.
texts.speaker: Naked

texts.text: <We'll have to head back to Palette if we want any answers about this "L'Incolore".>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: This sobbing. So vivid.
texts.speaker: King of Needleworks

texts.text: Black... Not here...! Far away... still far...!
texts.speaker: King of Needleworks

texts.text: Ha. Ha. Hahaha. Again, the feast...!
texts.speaker: King of Needleworks

texts.text: <What is that thing?!>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Withdrawing from this position will compromise the production of the skein, Executive Manager.

texts.text: Get ready for a fight, C.H.

texts.text: Like it or not, it's upon us.
texts.speaker: Ryōshū

texts.text: <I don't think it's moving anymore.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <What in the world was that...?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Grrraaagh...!
texts.speaker: Blackthread

texts.text: You have brought the Golden Dye.
texts.speaker: B2F Floor Manager

texts.text: A radiant color steeped in sunlight... a beauty worthy of this thread, would you not agree?
texts.speaker: B2F Floor Manager

texts.text: I find myself coveting it in earnest, now that I see it with my own eyes.
texts.speaker: B2F Floor Manager

texts.text: The three faces of B2F's Floor Manager stared fixedly at Meursault's pocket. Before long, they lowered their heads and quietly accepted the cocoon.
They swarmed us rather quickly.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Got a M.U.G., those things.
texts.speaker: Ryōshū

texts.text: <Okay... and that means...?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: I cannot interpret acronyms that have not been used before, Manager.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Uh, she said... "Got a Mortally Urgent Gift, those things..."
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: The scabbard rattles angrily as Sinclair interprets Ryōshū's acronym.
But having caught a few scabbard-punches to the gut, Sincliar had already moved a fair bit away from Ryōshū.
<They were so small, too... Couldn't even keep track of where they were coming from.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <Guess we should pay more attention to the ground.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <"Tears," she said... "Burst some blubber-bubbles," she said...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: While the experiences at this department store has led me to expect unpredictability at every turn, the nature of those... tears still caught me off guard.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: *puff* made for a nice watch, though. Sobbing uncontrollably while doused under bucketfuls of technicolor... Got a kitschy charm to it.
texts.speaker: Ryōshū

texts.text: Let's try dying at least once to each color. That should do us good.
texts.speaker: Ryōshū

texts.text: <I don't see what good that'll do...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Now that they've lost their element of surprise, however, the only thing we need to watch out for are those puddles of dye they leave behind. This should be more than manageable, Executive Manager.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <Yeah, those puddles lingered for quite a while, huh?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <... Alright. Let's try this again.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <...! W-wait! The Golden Cocoon...?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Hm? The cocoon is still floating above Meursault's shoulder, Executive Manager.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <Phew... What a relief. I thought it'd been devoured with him.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Devoured? What do you—
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: It was devoured. But the cocoon still remains above my shoulder.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <So the cocoon came back, too... Is that because it's now linked to Meursault somehow?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: *puff* T.M.
texts.speaker: Ryōshū

texts.text: That acronym has been used to convey "Timepiece, Move," Manager.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <O-okay, where do you want me to move?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Tsk. I meant "time manipulated."
texts.speaker: Ryōshū

texts.text: <Time...?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Yeah, Outis is behaving a bit strangely, like she doesn't understand what just happened.
Not to mention how the cocoon's been restored, too... Which can only mean...
<Let's head outside and check what's going on.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Agh... So that's what those Needlekin do.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <We're going to have to continue taking down the Needlekin, too.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <Well... let's hurry back before that monster devours the Cocoon.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: We must prepare ourselves for the worst-case-scenario—it is possible that the Monster's already gotten its hands on the cocoon.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: That is the Floor Manager's room. It will not find it an easy place to enter.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <Hm... That's true. There were other customers waiting in line, too.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <Still, no reason to sit around and risk the worst. Let's head back to that corridor.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: What are you doing? How rude.

texts.text: It... it can't be...! Were you Rouge spies all along, after my personal designs...? Damned strangers!
